sanskrit:
एवं बहुविधा यज्ञा वितता ब्रह्मणो मुखे ।
कर्मजान्विद्धि तान्सर्वानेवं ज्ञात्वा विमोक्ष्यसे ॥ ४-३२॥
iast:
evaṃ bahuvidhā yajñā vitatā brahmaṇo mukhe
karmajānviddhi tānsarvānevaṃ jñātvā vimokṣyase 4-32
translation: Thus innumerable sacrifices lie spread out before BRAHMAN — (literally at the mouth or face of BRAHMAN ) — Know them all as born of action, and thus knowing, you shall be liberated.
